refute_b.reason: REFUTED: the modification's scope is a grab-bag whose parts are owned by different PEs in this same index — 'flight test, ground test' sits with 0604878C 'Aegis BMD Test' (which owns both 'Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD)' doc 97 and 'Aegis BMD Ground Test (GT)'), 'in-service support' with MD90 'Aegis BMD Hardware and Software', and only 'additional upgrades to Baseline 5.4' points at the 5.x development row. The headline name the announcement actually uses is the bare three-way-collided 'Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense', the record prints no appropriation, and one designator inside a mixed scope does not make 0603892C the unique owner of this action.

proposals.announcement_evidence: transition the Standard Missile-3 Block IIA program into production
proposals.rationale: Engineering services, analysis and material 'necessary to transition the Standard Missile-3 Block IIA program into production' — manufacturing readiness level compliance, sustained rate capability, tactical configuration readiness — on HQ0276-15-C-0003, the Block IIA development contract. Production-readiness engineering is development-line work by definition (the program has not yet transitioned), so 0603892C's 'Standard Missile-3 (SM-3) Block IIA Development' (doc 277) is the line whose own work this funds, not the MD14 procurement BLI that later buys the rounds. The named program is the contract's whole subject rather than a platform it supports. The record text stops before the appropriation sentence, which lens A should verify.

refute_a.reason: The appropriation the proposal left open is stated in the full text: "Fiscal 2017 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $13,817,608 will be obligated at the time of award" — RDT&E money on the Block IIA development contract, so the production-readiness engineering is funded by the development line rather than the MD14 production BLI, and the named program is the contract's entire subject, not a platform it supports.

refute_b.reason: REFUTED: the announcement names its subject as 'the Standard Missile-3 Block IIA program' being transitioned 'into production' — manufacturing readiness levels, sustained rate capability of two all-up rounds per month, tactical configuration readiness — and the closer index name for that is MD14's standalone 'SM-3 Block IIA' (program title 'SM-3 IIAs'), not 0603892C's row, which the announcement's words do not call development. Sharing a PIID with the FY2016 RDT&E all-up-round mods is weak identity evidence for new October-2017 scope, since a later mod on an existing vehicle can be funded from the procurement line that existed by then; nothing in this record breaks the tie toward the development PE.

proposals.announcement_evidence: overall Ground-Based Midcourse Defense (GMD) Element engineering, integration
proposals.rationale: The $5.021B GMD system integration, test and readiness (SITR) IDIQ names GMD unambiguously, but the name cannot be attributed to a single line from this index: 'The Ground-based Midcourse Defense (GMD)' is carried by 0603882C (Midcourse Defense Segment), 0604874C (Improved Homeland Defense Interceptors) and MD08 (procurement), and 0604887C carries 'Ground Based Midcourse Defense (GMD)' as well — a four-way owner collision with three of the four sharing the RDT&E appropriation, so the appropriation cannot break the tie the way it does for the SM-3 records. The scope compounds it: alongside element engineering and integration the contractor performs 'day-to-day systems operations and readiness' and 'routine maintenance', which is sustainment work whose home line is not established by the announcement. Name present, attribution not established — weak, not a link.
